items.title: Pay the claim (if not disputed) directly to the claimant
items.quote: Halten Sie die Forderung für berechtigt, begleichen Sie die Summe samt laufender Zinsen binnen zwei Wochen seit Zustellung dieses Bescheids direkt bei der Antragstellerin.
items.computation: The Zustellungsvermerk states personal service on Fri 20.11.2026, so the two-week period (§ 222 Abs. 1 ZPO i.V.m. § 187 Abs. 1 BGB) begins the next day, 21.11.2026 (the day of service itself is not counted). A two-week period ends, under § 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB, on the day of the second following week that bears the same name as the day of service, i.e. the Friday two weeks later: 04.12.2026. 04.12.2026 is a normal working day in Bayern (no public holiday), so no shift applies under § 222 Abs. 2 ZPO. Due date: 04.12.2026.

items.title: Notify Widerspruch (objection) to the Mahngericht
items.quote: Bestreiten Sie sie ganz oder zum Teil, teilen Sie dem Mahngericht innerhalb derselben Frist mit, dass Sie Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: The letter states this objection must reach the Mahngericht 'innerhalb derselben Frist' as the payment deadline, i.e. the same two-week period from service. Service occurred Fri 20.11.2026 (Zustellungsvermerk). Per § 222 Abs. 1 ZPO / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the period starts 21.11.2026; per § 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB it ends on the corresponding weekday two weeks later: Fri 04.12.2026. No weekend/holiday shift needed (§ 222 Abs. 2 ZPO) as 04.12.2026 is a normal working day in Bayern. Due date: 04.12.2026 (must arrive at the court by this date, not merely be posted).

warnings: This is a formally served court document (Mahnbescheid) listing a disputed claim (gym membership fees March–July 2026); the court has not checked whether the claim is justified ('Das Gericht hat ihren Anspruch nicht geprüft') — if Theresa disagrees with the claim she should file the Widerspruch using the enclosed form rather than pay, and ideally send it a few days before 04.12.2026 to be safe on arrival.

No bank account (IBAN) for payment is printed on this letter; if a separate payment request with bank details arrives from the claimant, verify the IBAN and payee name independently before paying anything, as fake dunning/collection letters are a known scam pattern.
